routing_decisions: ESC1 phase A and B sense pickups use bounded 0.12 mm In4 tracks; ESC1 C and ESC4 A use bounded In1 tracks. Exact-net, width, layer and area fixtures reject other use. High-current phase copper remains outer.
C57 moved 0.10 mm west and 0.20 mm north to shorten RP core LX to 1.804 mm and allow a component-face connection.
D10 moved beside boost bulk and U4. Principal supply path is 10.702 mm; the old-position straight-line lower bound was 34.433 mm.
U14 pin2 laser centre is 0.025 mm south of the triangular pad centre. Hole-to-other-copper clearance is 0.18465 mm; copper clearance is 0.10965 mm. No footprint move.
ESP VTX DATA and CS laser lands use empty under-package space to avoid gyro CS and INT routing on In1. All normal drill/copper/mask limits remain.
Full In1/In4 GND zones supplement higher-priority local references. In2 remains continuous GND; In3 carries the battery plane.
All geometry comparisons normalize native filled polygons with SHAPE_POLY_SET.Unfracture before measuring holes, width or connectivity. Zero-width fracture seams are not physical slots.

OSD_LVL uses two F/In1 lasers and a bounded0.12mm In1 corridor. PA_DET uses boundedIn1/In4 corridors, short B finish and localIn3GND return; repaired return strip preserves all12 before-PA battery-entry geometric widths.
U16.2 WiFi pad reference is restored by replacing HD_EN detour with6 In4 tracks and removing2 buried vias.
Receiver MISO/MOSI/SCK/NSS are short direct F routes between U16 and U18. J23-to-OSD video links locally; J32 connector video is still open.

All four FC-U24 inputs and U24-ESC outputs are routed. Motor1 usesGPIO5 andU24 A2/B2; motor3 usesGPIO7 andU24 A0/B0, retaining external ESC identities. The permutation saves roughly5.4mm on motor1 versus the unchanged-channel trial.

Sixteen GND lasers use existing In1/In4 ground pours; rejected extra buried vias would have unnecessarily narrowed the BATT plane. Four direct controller pin-to-exposed-pad links and two offset capacitor lasers close all198 GND pads.
The RX_EN buried portal moves to110.06,120.53 and C70 supply portal to121.55,121.10 to restore the common eastern BATT feed. No new plane outline or MOSFET position change.

Added remaining support supply inputs, receiver BOOT and main switched 3.3 V VTX distribution; no footprint movement, no new rule areas, no reduction of the 24 measured motor battery entry widths; three duplicate new VTX segments removed
